reasoning: A full-size school bus has about 10 × 2.3 × 1.9 m inside, minus seats ≈ 40 m³.
A shoebox is about 33 × 19 × 12 cm, stacked like bricks: about 7,524 cm³ each.
They fill only about 95% of the space; the rest is gaps.
questions.fact: Shape matters: neat stacking fills 95% of the space, far more than a random heap.
